acceptanceCriteria: A1: GovernancePolicy rules can declare an explicit VerificationRequirement with tier assurance and policy stage gate traceability; T3 never implies ProviderVerified or EnterpriseVerified

A2: Planner output is derived only from ordered Organization Project and Work Item policy layers and records source policy ids and escalation reasons and fails closed when a requirement or traceability reference is missing
A3: Lower policy layers cannot weaken a higher layer verification tier assurance or required evidence; planner does not hide policy inside operation heuristics
A4: Historical generated artifact orphans WI-139C and WI-139F are reconciled into their immutable archive records with manifest-bound digests leaving no active approach orphan
A5: Unknown policy fields invalid requirements missing operation rules and unsupported stage or protected-gate references fail closed with stable errors
A6: Tri-language documentation explains policy-to-planner traceability the independent tier and assurance dimensions and the historical artifact reconciliation
goal: Make policy and stage the sole source of verification requirements while preserving independent assurance semantics and repairing known historical artifact orphans.
intent: Implement a traceable policy-driven verification planner without introducing a second tier semantic or inferring governance decisions from operation names.
outOfScope: dependency confidence and affected verification graph

scenarioCoverage.expected: An ordered policy stack yields a traceable independent tier and assurance requirement or stops with a stable reason.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run protocol policy overlay tests, planner tests, archive reconciliation checks, lint, and documentation acceptance.
